card.name: Punctuation closing a dosing clause
card.fires_on: Punctuation marks such as a comma, period, closing parenthesis, asterisks or a dash that come right after a dose, condition or instruction phrase in drug-label dosing text. Often it is a footnote asterisk or a bracket after a dose amount.

modes.label: Footnote asterisks
modes.description: Asterisk marks after a dose or table entry that begin or tag a footnote.
modes.example: Starting Dose: 10 mg/kg per day<<*>> Dose (mg) Sapropter

modes.label: Closing bracket after a dose
modes.description: A closing parenthesis plus asterisks right after a dose and interval in an interaction table.

modes.label: Comma or period ending a clause
modes.description: A comma or period that ends an instruction clause or condition in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: Before initiating TAGRISSO monotherapy in patients with cardiac risk factors<< ,>> conduct cardiac monitoring

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation marks, like commas, asterisks and brackets, that follow a dose or condition in label text.
